ai.literal: Possessing love, being born in a noble family, and possessing the good qualities desired by the king, are the qualities of one who delivers an embassy.
ai.translation: An affectionate nature, birth in a noble family, and possessing the refined qualities esteemed by kings are the essential attributes of an envoy who delivers a message.
ai.modern: அன்பு கொண்டிருத்தல், சிறந்த குடியில் பிறந்திருத்தல், அரசன் விரும்பும் நற்பண்புகளைப் பெற்றிருத்தல் ஆகிய இவை மூன்றும் தூது உரைப்பவனின் தகுதிகள் ஆகும்.
ai.explanation: This couplet outlines the three fundamental qualities required of a successful envoy. First, they must possess genuine love and loyalty towards their own king and country. Second, they must come from an honorable and noble lineage, which gives them natural dignity and credibility. Third, they must possess the refined manners and pleasing qualities that kings appreciate, ensuring they can communicate effectively with foreign rulers.

ai.literal: Love, wisdom, and well-considered power of speech—to those who deliver messages, these are the three indispensable things.
ai.translation: Loyalty, wisdom, and a well-considered power of speech are the three indispensable qualities for an envoy who delivers a message.
ai.modern: அன்பு, அறிவு, ஆராய்ந்து பேசும் சொல்வன்மை ஆகிய மூன்றும் தூது உரைப்பவருக்கு இன்றியமையாத தகுதிகள் ஆகும்.
ai.explanation: This couplet outlines the three essential qualities required for a successful diplomat or envoy. First, 'anpu' represents loyalty and affection towards their sovereign, ensuring they act in the state's best interest. Second, 'aṟivu' represents the intellect and wisdom needed to navigate complex political situations. Third, 'colvaṉmai' combined with 'ārāynta' refers to a highly refined, well-considered eloquence that allows them to deliver messages persuasively and tactfully. The poet emphasizes that these three attributes are absolutely indispensable for anyone undertaking a diplomatic mission.

ai.literal: Among those learned in treatises, becoming an expert in treatises, and among those with spears, delivering a mission of victory, is the quality of an envoy.
ai.translation: To be an expert among those learned in books, and to deliver a mission of victory among spear-bearing kings, is the true quality of an envoy.
ai.modern: நூல்களைக் கற்றவர்களுள் நூல் அறிவு மிக்கவனாக விளங்குவதும், வேல் ஏந்திய அரசர்களுள் சென்று தன் அரசனுக்கு வெற்றியைத் தரும் தூதுச் செய்தியைச் சொல்வதும் ஒரு தூதனின் தகுதியாகும்.
ai.explanation: This couplet outlines the essential qualities of a successful diplomat or envoy. First, the envoy must be highly learned, standing out as an expert even when surrounded by other scholars of political and ethical treatises. Second, when standing before spear-bearing kings who hold military power, the envoy must possess the eloquence to deliver their mission in a way that secures victory. Thus, intellectual supremacy and persuasive speech under pressure are the defining traits of an envoy.

ai.literal: Intellect, appearance, deeply studied learning—he who has the fullness of these three, let him go for the mission.
ai.translation: Let him who possesses the perfect combination of these three qualities—natural intellect, a dignified appearance, and deeply studied learning—go forth on an envoy's mission.
ai.modern: இயற்கை அறிவு, தோற்றப் பொலிவு, ஆராய்ந்து கற்ற கல்வி ஆகிய இம்மூன்றின் செறிவை உடையவன் தூதுச் செயலுக்குச் செல்லட்டும்.
ai.explanation: This couplet outlines the three essential personal qualities required for an envoy before they are sent on a diplomatic mission. First is natural intellect (அறிவு), which allows them to think critically and respond wisely. Second is a dignified or pleasing appearance (உரு), which commands immediate respect and creates a favorable impression. Third is deeply studied learning (கல்வி), ensuring they are well-versed in statecraft and history. One who possesses the fullness (செறிவு) of these three attributes is the ideal candidate to represent a state.

ai.literal: Speaking concisely, avoiding disagreeable things, speaking pleasantly, yielding benefit is the mission of an envoy.
ai.translation: To speak concisely, to avoid disagreeable words, and to speak so as to please, thereby yielding a beneficial result, is the true mission of an envoy.
ai.modern: விஷயங்களைச் சுருக்கமாகச் சொல்லி, வெறுப்புத் தரும் சொற்களைத் தவிர்த்து, கேட்பவர் மகிழுமாறு பேசி, நன்மையைத் தருவதே சிறந்த தூது ஆகும்.
ai.explanation: This couplet outlines the essential communication strategy of a successful diplomat. First, the envoy must present the core message concisely to maintain the listener's attention. Second, they must carefully filter out any offensive or disagreeable remarks that could provoke hostility. Third, they must speak in a pleasing, winning manner to foster goodwill. By combining these three qualities, the envoy's speech yields a beneficial outcome for their state.

ai.literal: Having learned, not fearing the presence of others, speaking so as to penetrate their minds, and knowing that which is appropriate according to the time, is the role of an envoy.
ai.translation: An envoy is one who is highly learned, fearless in the presence of others, speaks so that his words penetrate the listener's mind, and knows what is appropriate for the opportune moment.
ai.modern: நன்கு கற்று, எதற்கும் அஞ்சாமல், கேட்பவர் மனதில் பதியுமாறு பேசி, காலத்திற்கு ஏற்றவாறு பொருத்தமானதை அறிந்து செயல்படுவதே சிறந்த தூது ஆகும்.
ai.explanation: This couplet outlines the essential qualifications and duties of a successful diplomat or envoy. First, they must be deeply educated ('கற்று') and possess the courage to speak without flinching in the presence of powerful rulers ('கண் அஞ்சான்'). Second, they must communicate persuasively, making their message penetrate and convince the listener's mind ('செலச் சொல்லி'). Finally, they must have the wisdom to discern what is fitting ('தக்கது') and act in accordance with the specific timing and circumstances ('காலத்தால்').

ai.literal: Duty having known, time having considered, place having known, having deliberated, he who speaks is the foremost.
ai.translation: He who knows his duty, considers the right time, understands the proper place, and speaks after careful deliberation is the foremost envoy.
ai.modern: தன் கடமையை அறிந்து, ஏற்ற காலத்தைக் கருதி, தகுந்த இடத்தை அறிந்து, நன்கு ஆராய்ந்து பேசுகின்ற தூதனே சிறந்தவன் ஆவான்.
ai.explanation: This couplet defines the qualities of an outstanding envoy or messenger. The poet outlines four essential steps for delivering a message effectively: knowing one's duty, choosing the right time, finding the appropriate place, and thinking deeply before speaking. An envoy who possesses these qualities and speaks with such preparation is considered the best or foremost in their role. The progression of verbs emphasizes the meticulous preparation required for successful diplomacy.

ai.literal: Purity, companionship, courage-possession, of these three, truthfulness, is the quality of him who delivers the message in the proper way.
ai.translation: Purity of character, influential allies, and courage—the genuine possession of these three qualities defines an envoy who delivers a message.
ai.modern: தூய்மையான ஒழுக்கம், நல்ல துணை, துணிவு ஆகிய இம்மூன்றையும் உண்மையாகப் பெற்றிருப்பதே தூது உரைப்பவரின் தகுதியாகும்.
ai.explanation: This couplet outlines the three indispensable qualities of a successful envoy. First is 'தூய்மை' (purity), which denotes flawless integrity and moral uprightness, ensuring the envoy cannot be corrupted. Second is 'துணைமை' (companionship), which refers to having powerful allies or the tact to win over others. Third is 'துணிவுடைமை' (possession of courage), which allows the envoy to deliver difficult messages fearlessly in a foreign court. The genuine ('வாய்மை') presence of these three attributes constitutes the true character of one who speaks on behalf of a ruler.

ai.literal: The sent message to kings he who delivers, blemish-causing words mouth not reaching, a courageous man.
ai.translation: He who delivers a sent message to other kings must be a man of steadfast courage, whose mouth never utters words that bring blemish or ruin.
ai.modern: அனுப்பப்பட்ட செய்தியை மாற்றரசர்களுக்குச் சொல்பவன், தன் வாயிலிருந்து குற்றம் தரும் சொற்கள் வெளிவராதவாறு காக்கும் அஞ்சாத நெஞ்சமுடையவன் ஆவான்.
ai.explanation: This couplet defines the essential quality of an envoy when delivering a message to foreign rulers. The envoy must be a person of steadfast courage, referred to as 'vaṉkaṇavaṉ', who does not falter under pressure or threat. Crucially, even in difficult situations, his mouth must never slip to utter 'vaṭumāṟṟam'—faulty, weak, or damaging words that could bring disgrace to his own king. The word 'māṟṟam' is used beautifully in two senses: 'viṭumāṟṟam' refers to the official message sent, while 'vaṭumāṟṟam' refers to flawed words of blame.

ai.literal: Even if it yields death, without shrinking back, that which yields benefit to the king is the envoy.
ai.translation: A true envoy is one who, even if their mission brings about their own death, does not shrink back but delivers what is of ultimate benefit to their king.
ai.modern: தனக்கு அழிவே நேர்ந்தாலும் தயங்காமல், தன் அரசனுக்கு நன்மையைத் தருவதே உண்மையான தூது ஆகும்.
ai.explanation: This couplet defines the ultimate duty and courage of an envoy. The word 'iṟuti' here refers to death or destruction, highlighting the high-stakes nature of ancient diplomacy where messengers could be executed by hostile rulers. Even when faced with such mortal peril, a true envoy does not falter or shrink back ('eñcātu'). Instead, they remain steadfastly committed to securing the ultimate benefit and safety ('uṟuti') for their own sovereign ('iṟaivaṟku').
